description: Unit-test coverage (fix H). Add tests for parseAiJson from src/providers/common.ts, history.ts IndexedDB CRUD + pruneHistory (using fake-indexeddb), and OpenRouter/Gemini HTTP request shape (mocked fetch). Keep all existing tests passing; no new skips beyond the 3 pre-existing live-API tests. Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: INSTALL — Add exact-pinned devDependency to package.json: `"fake-indexeddb": "6.2.6"`. Run `npm install`.

NEW FILE — tests/parse-ai-json.test.ts (node env, no docblock needed): Import `{ parseAiJson }` from `'../src/providers/common'`. Test cases grounded in the actual parseAiJson implementation (strips ```json...``` fences, finds outermost {}, uses JSON.parse, str() returns undefined for empty strings): (1) fenced ```json\n{"bengaliMeaning":"x"}\n``` → bengaliMeaning === 'x'; (2) plain unfenced {"englishDefinition":"y"} → englishDefinition === 'y'; (3) synonyms as string array ['a','b'] → returned as ['a','b']; (4) synonyms with non-string elements ["a",1,"b"] → ['a','b'] (non-strings filtered by arr() helper); (5) malformed 'not json at all' (no braces) → null; (6) broken JSON '{broken:' → null; (7) nested braces in value: '{"exampleEn":"a {b} c","bengaliMeaning":"x"}' → exampleEn === 'a {b} c' (lastIndexOf('}') captures outer closing brace); (8) empty string fields: '{"bengaliMeaning":""}' → bengaliMeaning is undefined (str() returns undefined for empty-after-trim strings).

NEW FILE — tests/history.test.ts (node env): `import { IDBFactory } from 'fake-indexeddb'`. In beforeEach: `globalThis.indexedDB = new IDBFactory()` (fresh in-memory instance per test — no deleteDatabase needed). Import addHistory, listHistory, updateHistory, deleteHistory, clearHistory, listSaved, pruneHistory from '../src/storage/history'. Define a helper makeEntry(overrides) that returns a valid HistoryEntry. Tests: (1) addHistory returns a positive number id; (2) listHistory returns entries sorted desc by timestamp (add two entries timestamp:1 and timestamp:2, expect timestamp:2 first); (3) updateHistory patches the entry (add entry, update {saved:true}, listHistory shows saved:true); (4) deleteHistory removes the entry (listHistory returns empty after); (5) clearHistory empties the store (add 2 entries, clear, listHistory returns []); (6) listSaved returns only saved:true entries; (7) pruneHistory(2) — add 3 entries with timestamps 100, 200, 300; after pruneHistory(2) listHistory returns 2 entries with timestamps 300 and 200 (timestamp:100 deleted); (8) pruneHistory(0) is a no-op (limit <= 0, returns early); (9) pruneHistory(Infinity) is a no-op (catches non-finite).

NEW FILE — tests/providers.test.ts (node env): Mirror tests/groq-models.test.ts style. Import { openRouterLookup } from '../src/providers/openrouter'; import { geminiLookup } from '../src/providers/gemini'. Read src/providers/gemini/index.ts FIRST to confirm the exact URL pattern (generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent?key={apiKey}) and body shape (contents array with role/parts, generationConfig.responseMimeType). In beforeEach: vi.restoreAllMocks(). For openRouterLookup tests: set globalThis.fetch = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, json: async () => ({ choices: [{ message: { content: '{"bengaliMeaning":"x","englishDefinition":"y"}' } }] }), text: async () => '' }). Test: call openRouterLookup('hello', false, { apiKey: 'test-key', enabled: true, model: 'openai/gpt-4o-mini' }, 'r1') and assert: (a) fetch called with URL 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions'; (b) method === 'POST'; (c) Authorization header === 'Bearer test-key'; (d) JSON.parse(body).model === 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'; (e) JSON.parse(body).response_format.type === 'json_object'. For geminiLookup tests: set globalThis.fetch = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, json: async () => ({ candidates: [{ content: { parts: [{ text: '{"bengaliMeaning":"x"}' }] } }] }), text: async () => '' }). Call geminiLookup('hello', false, { apiKey: 'test-gemini-key', enabled: true, model: 'gemini-2.0-flash' }, 'r1') and assert: (a) URL includes ':generateContent?key=test-gemini-key'; (b) URL includes 'gemini-2.0-flash'; (c) JSON.parse(body).generationConfig.responseMimeType === 'application/json'; (d) JSON.parse(body).contents exists (is an array with role 'user' entry).
acceptance_criteria: tests/history.test.ts passes all CRUD + pruneHistory cases using fake-indexeddb
tests/providers.test.ts passes OpenRouter and Gemini request-shape assertions
All existing tests still pass; only the 3 pre-existing live-API tests skip
